# Code Anchors: Live Backlog

- `libs/app/src/backlogload.ts` — reads the query and ancestor chains, names failure causes, builds and filters the tree
- `libs/app/src/livebacklog.tsx` — the live backlog panel: loading, failure and Try again, rows, outside parents, the cap note
- `libs/app/src/livebacklog.test.tsx` — tree shape, load and failure states, stale answers, read-only rows
- `libs/app/src/outsideparents.test.tsx` — outside parents, deep ancestor rounds, parents in another repository, loops
- `libs/app/src/testing/fakegraph.ts` — a fake GitHub GraphQL endpoint for the backlog tests
- `libs/app/src/app.css` — live backlog row depth, outside-parent and status styles
- `libs/app/src/grooming.tsx` — shows the live backlog in place of the sample backlog when a source is given
